name: University of Manitoba
summary: Winnipeg university founded in 1877 with 27,000+ undergraduates, 100+ undergraduate programs and co-op or internship options.

ib.text: Three HL and three SL courses with an overall minimum of 24 points; the program then asks an average over four courses, from 4 (70%) for Arts to 6 (85%) for Commerce, Health Sciences and Kinesiology.

dates.label: Apply by this date to enter the draw for a CAD 5,000 tuition credit

programmes.name: Engineering
programmes.about: A common first year in maths and science, then Biosystems, Civil, Computer, Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, with smaller classes and an optional paid Co-op and Industrial Internship Program.
programmes.ib: English, Maths (AA, or AI HL), Chemistry and Physics; an average of 6 (80%), no grade below 4. Canadians are preferred.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on a 6 (80%) average over English, Maths, Chemistry and Physics, two at HL; Canadians are preferred, with at least 10% of places for international students.

flagshipSource.title: Engineering (BSc): smaller classes, common first year and a Co-op/Industrial Internship Program

programmes.name: Computer Science
programmes.about: A mathematically rich, theory-based degree in how computers work and carry out tasks in software, with research labs from robotics to bioinformatics and an optional Science Co-op.
programmes.ib: Enter through Science: English, Maths (AA, or AI HL), one of Biology, Chemistry, Physics or Computer Science, and a fourth course; an average of 6 (80%).
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on a 6 (80%) average over four courses, two at HL, with no grade below 3; higher averages are needed when applicants outnumber places.

flagshipSource.title: Computer Science (BSc): research labs from robotics to bioinformatics, with a Co-op option

faculties.name: Price Faculty of Engineering
faculties.line: English, Maths, Chemistry and Physics; an average of 6 (80%), no grade below 4; Canadians preferred.

faculties.name: Faculty of Science
faculties.line: English, Maths and a lab science or Computer Science; an average of 6 (80%) over four courses, no grade below 3.

faculties.name: Business (Commerce)
faculties.line: Commerce: English and Maths (AA, or AI HL) plus two more; an average of 6 (85%) with no grade below 4.

faculties.name: Faculty of Arts
faculties.line: English, Maths and two more academic courses; an average of 4 (70%), no grade below 3.

faculties.name: Faculty of Agricultural and Food Sciences
faculties.line: English, Maths and two more academic courses; an average of 4 (70%), no grade below 3.

faculties.name: Clayton H. Riddell Faculty of Environment, Earth, and Resources
faculties.line: Environmental Science and Earth Sciences need English, Maths, Physics and a science; Geography needs English and Maths; 4 (70%).

faculties.name: Faculty of Kinesiology and Recreation Management
faculties.line: Kinesiology needs English, Maths, and Biology, Chemistry or Physics; an average of 6 (85%) over four courses.

faculties.name: Interdisciplinary Health (Health Sciences, Health Studies)
faculties.line: Health Sciences needs English, Maths, Biology and Chemistry at an average of 6 (85%), no grade below 3.

faculties.name: Fine Arts and Music
faculties.line: Fine Arts needs a portfolio and statement; Music an audition, theory test and recommendations, with a January deadline.

notes: Not sure of your degree? University 1 takes an average of 4 (70%) over English, Maths and two more courses, and you choose your faculty after the first year.
The university publishes CAD 28,000 as the average first-year international tuition and fees; Engineering gives preference to Canadian citizens and permanent residents.
